install_method: source at upstream_commit installed with --no-deps over requirements.lock
notes: v3.4.2 replaces the cuEquivariance kernel backend with upstream Triton kernels (reference/fused/fast) and defaults the ESMC backbone to fp8. The adapter selects fused by default and deliberately retains ESMC_PRECISION=bf16; every prediction records both the kernel backend and the bf16 choice. The fast backend enables an approximate bf16 MSA-encoder triangle multiplication and remains opt-in. The provisioned standard/fast/ESMC-6B weights are unchanged and remain hash-verified before loading.
